title: dnd-5e-2024 class option stats (docs/rulesets.md#classes)
description: A component of a class (docs/content-model.md#components): one option of an option list, such as a Metamagic option or an Eldritch Invocation, printed under the list on its class's page.

prerequisite.description: Printed under the name as "Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock, Pact of the Blade Invocation", with a token for an option it names.

repeatable.description: Printed last as "Repeatable." and the text, as a feat's.
